decks.notes: This deck aims to quickly assemble a powerful equipment combo using Puresteel Paladin, Sigarda's Aid, and Stoneforge Mystic to cheat out Colossus Hammer and equip it onto a creature like Inkmoth Nexus or Ornithopter for a potential one-shot kill. The deck also utilizes Urza's Saga to search for key pieces and control elements like Spell Pierce and Teferi, Time Raveler to protect the combo. By combining fast mana acceleration and efficient equipment, this deck can surprise opponents with its speed and explosive potential.

The main concept of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to aggressively disrupt the opponent's game plan while applying consistent pressure with a mix of efficient creatures and removal spells. The deck focuses on utilizing cards like Thoughtseize, Grief, and Dauthi Voidwalker to disrupt the opponent's hand and graveyard, while cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Seasoned Pyromancer provide a constant stream of threats. The deck also includes powerful removal spells like Terminate and Fatal Push to efficiently deal with any opposing threats. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent quickly and efficiently to secure victory.

The deck focuses on assembling the Amulet of Vigor combo with bounce lands and utility lands to generate large amounts of mana quickly. By cheating Primeval Titan into play, it can search for key lands like Vesuva and Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle to set up lethal Valakut triggers. Dryad of the Ilysian Grove allows for additional land drops and fixing, while Urza's Saga provides additional toolbox options. The deck aims to ramp quickly and efficiently to overwhelm opponents with its powerful land-based threats and combo potential.

The deck focuses on quickly casting cheap Cascade spells like Violent Outburst to put powerful cards into play for free, overwhelming the opponent with threats like Crashing Footfalls and big creatures like Murktide Regent. It also includes disruptive elements like Mystical Dispute and Force of Negation to protect its game plan. The mixture of aggression and card advantage provided by Cascade allows the deck to apply constant pressure and maintain tempo throughout the game, ensuring a fast and efficient victory against opponents.

The deck focuses on aggressive gameplay, using cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Grief to quickly apply pressure on the opponent. It also utilizes disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Terminate to control the board and hinder the opponent's strategy. The inclusion of cards like Undying Malice and Feign Death allows for synergy with other creatures in the deck, while Seasoned Pyromancer provides card advantage. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with efficient threats and disrupt their game plan in order to secure a quick victory.

This deck focuses on utilizing the combo of Indomitable Creativity and token-generating lands such as Dwarven Mine to cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty early in the game. The inclusion of Teferi, Time Raveler helps protect the combo and disrupt opponent's strategies, while cards like Lightning Bolt and Spell Pierce provide additional control. The deck also features some land manipulation with cards like Wrenn and Six and Prismatic Ending for added flexibility. Overall, the deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm opponents with big threats.

The deck revolves around utilizing Indomitable Creativity to transform low-cost tokens from Dwarven Mine into high-impact creatures like Archon of Cruelty. With the combination of Teferi, Time Raveler and Spell Pierce for protection, the deck aims to quickly assemble a game-winning board state through creative means. Wrenn and Six provide consistent land drops, while Fable of the Mirror-Breaker can help generate additional tokens. The deck's variety of lands and spells allow for flexibility and adaptability in different matchups, making it a versatile and unpredictable combo deck in Modern.

The main concept of this Dredge combo deck is to fill the graveyard quickly and efficiently by using cards like Cathartic Reunion, Darkblast, and Tome Scour. Once the graveyard is stocked, the deck can take advantage of powerful graveyard synergies with cards like Prized Amalgam and Ox of Agonas. The goal is to eventually bring back a large number of creatures from the graveyard in a single turn, overwhelming the opponent with a strong board presence and potentially finishing them off with a Conflagrate for lethal damage.

The main concept of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to disrupt the opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize and Grief, while applying pressure with aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Seasoned Pyromancer. The deck also aims to control the board with removal spells like Terminate and Lightning Bolt. Blood Moon is included to disrupt opponents' mana bases, giving the deck an edge in certain matchups. The inclusion of cards like Feign Death and Undying Malice provide combat tricks and potential to recur creatures for additional value. The deck aims to win quickly through a combination of disruption and aggression.

This deck focuses on quickly casting spells with cascade to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive threats. By utilizing cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst, the deck can quickly put powerful creatures like Crashing Footfalls and Murktide Regent onto the battlefield. The deck also includes disruption spells like Dead / Gone and Force of Negation to help protect its game plan. With a streamlined mana base and efficient interaction, this deck aims to outpace and overpower opponents in the Modern format.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and spells that cascade into larger threats. By utilizing Cascade mechanics, the deck can quickly flood the board with powerful creatures like Crashing Footfalls and Murktide Regent, while also disrupting the opponent's strategy with cards like Mystical Dispute and Force of Negation. The deck aims to control the tempo of the game by constantly applying pressure and forcing the opponent to react to the cascading threats, ultimately leading to a swift victory.

This deck focuses on assembling the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Mine, Power Plant, and Tower) to generate a large amount of mana quickly. It aims to control the game by countering spells, bouncing threats back to the opponent's hand, and disrupting their strategy with cards like Karn, the Great Creator. The deck also includes powerful threats like Wurmcoil Engine and Ugin, the Spirit Dragon to close out the game once it has established control. It utilizes a mix of card draw, mana acceleration, and versatile removal spells to maintain board presence and outvalue the opponent.

The main idea of this deck is to utilize cards that interact with artifacts and tokens to create a powerful combo that can quickly overwhelm the opponent. By using cards like Indomitable Creativity and Archon of Cruelty, the deck aims to create a board state that is difficult for the opponent to handle. This combo-centric strategy requires careful planning and decision-making to maximize the effectiveness of the cards in the deck. Additionally, cards like Wrenn and Six and Teferi, Time Raveler provide additional value and protection for the combo pieces.

This deck focuses on aggressive play and utilizing the Cascade mechanic to cast powerful spells for free. By cascading into cards like Crashing Footfalls and Dead / Gone, the deck can quickly overwhelm the opponent with creature tokens and removal spells. The deck also includes some control elements like Cryptic Command and Mystical Dispute to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Overall, the deck aims to apply early pressure and maintain a tempo advantage through efficient spells and Cascade triggers.

The deck focuses on a fast-paced aggressive strategy, utilizing efficient removal spells and disruptive discard spells to control the opponent's resources. It also includes powerful threats like Tarmogoyf, Seasoned Pyromancer, and Wrenn and Six to apply pressure on the opponent. The inclusion of versatile cards like Kolaghan's Command and Abrupt Decay allows for flexibility in dealing with a variety of threats. Additionally, the deck utilizes cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger to provide additional card advantage and potential board presence. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with its aggressive game plan.

The deck focuses on quickly lowering its own life total to bolster the power of Death's Shadow and Murktide Regent, powerful threats that can end the game quickly if left unanswered. It also includes a mix of disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Counterspell to control the opponent's game plan, along with removal spells like Fatal Push and Dismember to handle opposing threats. The deck aims to be aggressive, disrupting the opponent's strategy while deploying efficient threats to close out the game as quickly as possible.
